verdict.rationale: incident.io documents on-call schedules, but its only calendar-feed feature runs the other way: it imports personal holidays from an iCal feed into incident.io and shows them next to shifts. Nothing in the pack shows shifts being exported as a subscribable feed for a personal calendar. Webhooks that sync schedule changes are a developer building block, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, my shifts sync to my personal calendar via a feed so I always know when I'm on the hook
